title: A Wild Day in Rotterdam
description: Spent a sunny day at Rotterdam Zoo, moving from the shade of the elephant enclosure to the sandy home of the prairie dogs. A different side of the city, and an easy favourite.
coverAlt: A herd of Asian elephants gathered in a leafy enclosure at Rotterdam Zoo on a sunny day

images.alt: Several Asian elephants, including a young elephant, gathered beside rocks and a shallow pool in a leafy enclosure at Rotterdam Zoo
images.caption: The elephant herd keeping cool together at Rotterdam Zoo.

images.alt: A prairie dog standing upright on sandy ground in bright sunlight at Rotterdam Zoo
images.caption: This little prairie dog had the best lookout spot in the zoo.
